text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Console telemetry work for Q2: dashboards + tracing hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics. Customers keep asking for per-route cost and traceable request IDs. Can we agree an MVP?

Arjun: MVP suggestion: latency + error dashboards, basic trace correlation (trace_id + span), cost rollup by model/route. Defer per-token billing calc to v1.1.

Sam: +1. Must include sampling policy and 100% capture on errors. Also fallback to minimal spans so ingestion doesn't blow up.

Lina: I can design a compact dashboard template (2 tiles) showing latency and cost, plus a small error card. Will share mocks.

Nora: For cost estimates we can do daily rollups by route/model using existing billing events, but per-token needs a small telemetry change: add `token_count` to runtime events. That is doable but needs runtime and privacy check.

Maya: OK — Nora add to spec. Arjun, how much to add `token_count` and ensure `trace_id` header flows through?

Arjun: token_count field: small change, ~2 dev days. trace_id propagation: runtime already has span_id, but UI ingestion and docs need work — ~3 days. These can run in parallel.

Maya: Draft launch criteria and ACs — keeping it narrow for GA:
```text
ACs:
- Dashboard: latency (p50/p95), error rate, and cost by model/route
- Tracing: request/span id propagation, sample 0.5% default + 100% on errors
- Cost: daily rollup and per-route estimate (explicitly no per-token calc in v1)
- Errors: grouping UI + pointer to root-cause traces
- Rollout: canary 5% tenants -> 50% -> 100% with auto-rollback on error/ingest regressions
SLOs:
- Ingestion latency < 5s (90th)
- Missing traces < 1% for sampled traffic
```

Arjun: Need a customer opt-in flag for `token_count` until legal/KMS are cleared. Also watch quantized model backends — token offsets can be noisy.

Sam: Ops asks: retention defaults should be 30d for traces, 90d for aggregated metrics. Need a simple UI toggle per-tenant to change retention. Also document sampling config.

Lina: UX ask: add "compare to baseline" toggle on the dashboard and a compact cost breakdown card that fits 3 lines (model, route, est daily cost).

Maya: Customer prioritization (from CS): 1) per-route cost estimate, 2) error analytics with grouping and links to traces, 3) traces linked to request IDs. Enterprise A will push for per-token so schedule v1.1 roadmap item.

Nora: I'll prepare sample datasets and a small eval harness to validate cost estimates vs actual billing.

Maya: Action items:
- Nora: telemetry schema PR (adds `token_count` + `trace_id` ingestion sample) by Tue
- Arjun: runtime ingestion + UI hook estimate PR by Wed
- Lina: dashboard + cost card mockups by Thu
- Sam: retention + sampling defaults doc by Thu
I will open the spec PR and ping infra for compliance review.

buildbot: Spec PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/specs/pull/438 :eyes:

Arjun: I'll review the spec PR tonight.

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll set a 30min sync Fri 10:00 to finalize canary config. :thumbsup:
